environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed on AWS Lambda via custom runtime. Function runs as root inside the Lambda execution environment. The /app/workspace/uploads directory is writable. The Lambda function has IAM role with S3 and DynamoDB access. No filesystem isolation beyond standard Lambda sandbox. The function processes user-uploaded ZIP archives from an API Gateway endpoint with no request validation beyond size limits.

config.api_gateway: REST API with binary media type support
